registration.note: Engineering run of the P0 BSP pipeline on the free 2015-05..2016-04 BASIC corpus, not a registered hypothesis: it is judged only by engineering_acceptance, and its financial_rule is not_applicable. decision_timing.delay_s and stopping_rule.max_trials stay null until task (c) fixes them, before the freeze and before any run.

financial_rule.reason: Engineering check: no financial hypothesis, ROI threshold or decision rule applies. No result of this run can support or refute an edge: the 2015-2016 year says nothing about a current edge, and the engineering months count as inspected from the first run on.

criteria.name: issuance_exposure_reconciliation
criteria.definition: Per variant: the issuance ledger has exactly one row per cohort (market, runner, decision point), none dropped after outcomes; every row has exactly one outcome: issued; not_selected (the variant did not abstain for the market and backed another runner, or none: the plan's watch); abstained, with its decision-time reason; or unsupported, with the missing capabilities.decision input. The counts by outcome and reason sum to the row count; issued bets equal resolved plus unresolved bets, and issued stakes equal S_R plus S_U.

criteria.name: known_accounting_answers
criteria.definition: Every synthetic fixture in docs/backtest-plan.md section 9 reproduces its hand-computed answer to the penny at the fixture's own declared commission rate (at 2%: separate £1 BACK @ 2.0 win and loss net -£0.02; +£10 and -£10 in one market net 0 with no commission; the same in separate markets net -£0.20), and void, dead-heat, removal and missing-BSP fixtures come out unresolved with their stake kept as exposure.

criteria.name: prefix_invariance
criteria.definition: For every decision time t, a run on the stream truncated at t, and a run with every final BSP, result, removal and market definition published after t removed or revised, give decision records at or before t identical to the full run (decision IDs, abstain and unsupported reasons, intents); only settlement may change, including from resolved to unresolved.

cohort.market_rule: Every GB or IE horse-racing WIN market in the evaluated months whose first market definition was published at or before the decision time. Nothing published after the decision time admits or drops a market.
cohort.runner_rule: Every runner ACTIVE in the latest market definition published at or before the decision time. A runner removed later keeps its decision in the issuance ledger.
exclusions: No market definition published at or before the decision time: abstain (market_not_published_by_decision).
Market not OPEN, or already in play, in the latest definition at or before the decision time: abstain (market_not_open_pre_off).

A required decision-time capability (capabilities.decision) missing for the market or runner in the observed prefix at the decision time: abstain with that capability's unsupported reason; missing is never zero. A missing final BSP or result is no exclusion: the decision stands and its settlement is unresolved.

features.name: active_runner_count
features.definition: Number of ACTIVE runners in the latest market definition published at or before the decision time.

features.name: ltp_at_decision
features.definition: Each runner's last traded price published at or before the decision time (BASIC samples LTP at one minute); a runner with none has a missing value, not zero.

costs.note: Declared assumption, not any account's effective charge: 5% is the conservative example-config rate from a secondary source (fact F62; Betfair's own example is Basic 2%). marketBaseRate in the files does not establish the charge.

variants.description: Back at BSP the runner with the lowest ltp_at_decision; a tie or any missing ltp_at_decision abstains for the market.
Back at BSP one ACTIVE runner chosen from seeds.selection and the market id. An empirical baseline reported with its uncertainty, not an engine oracle.

stopping_rule.rule: Each declared variant runs over the whole engineering split; no variant, feature, cohort rule or cost is added, dropped or changed after outcomes are seen without a new contract and hash. Every started, failed, aborted or completed trial goes to the trial ledger with this contract's sha256.
